BowlbugRock.rule: Imbalanced calls the Bowlbug's Stun, which announces Dizzy; the conditional follow-up otherwise depends on off-balance state

LagavulinMatriarch.rule: Removes Plating where present, wakes and stuns with WakeUpMove, then follows to Slash; natural expiry at the end of its third sleeping turn wakes without that stun

Tunneler.rule: Stuns with StillDizzyMove, then follows to Bite and removes Burrowed

ThievingHopper.trigger: Five nonzero unblocked powered attacks exhaust Flutter
ThievingHopper.rule: Stuns, then uses the native next state from the last logged move; no such transition or RNG call is executed by this reference

EyeWithTeeth.trigger: Death under Illusion, without another removal prevention
EyeWithTeeth.rule: Creates a mandatory Revive move; follows the configured state or the last logged state and heals to full; the temporary state is not part of the original graph

Parafright.trigger: Death under Illusion, without another removal prevention
Parafright.rule: Creates a mandatory Revive move; follows the configured state or the last logged state and heals to full; the temporary state is not part of the original graph

CeremonialBeast.trigger: Nonzero unblocked damage leaves HP at or below Plow's amount
CeremonialBeast.rule: Removes Plow, stuns with the Beast's StunnedMove, then follows to Beast Cry and the second-phase cycle

TerrorEel.trigger: Nonzero unblocked damage leaves HP at or below Shriek's amount
TerrorEel.rule: Stuns with TerrorState as the follow-up; this is a reactive branch outside the original opening path

SlumberingBeetle.trigger: Slumber reaches zero from damage or its own turn countdown
SlumberingBeetle.rule: Nonzero unblocked damage decrements Slumber; at zero it stuns with WakeUpMove then follows to Roll Out; natural turn-countdown expiry calls WakeUpMove directly without that stun

PhrogParasite.rule: Produces four stunned Wrigglers in slots wriggler1 through wriggler4; combat end is prevented during the spawn

Axebot.rule: Replaces itself in the same slot with an Axebot with one less Stock; replacement opens Boot Up

Fogmog.rule: Adds Eye With Teeth to the illusion slot in live combat

TheObscura.rule: Adds Parafright to the illusion slot in live combat

LivingFog.rule: Adds Gas Bombs up to BloatAmount while encounter slots remain available

Ovicopter.rule: Adds up to three Tough Eggs in available slots, searching from the last slot

ToughEgg.rule: Hatches in place; Nibble is the later move and hatchling HP is a separate range

TwoTailedRat.rule: Adds another Two-Tailed Rat in the next free encounter slot; eligibility requires no summon countdown, fewer than three prior backups, an available slot and no teammate announcing Call For Backup; the weights stay symbolic
Three rats use distinct offsets modulo three; summoned rats use the random branch instead

Fabricator.rule: Deals a bot from its move-specific public pool, excluding the last spawned identity; the dealt identity is never read

GremlinMerc.rule: Adds Sneaky Gremlin and Fat Gremlin; Fat Gremlin is stunned on its spawn turn

Queen.rule: If Burn Bright For Me is announced, transition immediately to Enrage; later follow-ups enter the attack cycle

TestSubject.rule: Respawn is a mandatory heal/buff move; phase two repeats Multi Claw, phase three cycles Lacerate, Big Pounce, Burning Growl

DecimillipedeSegmentFront.rule: Transition to Dead, then mandatory Reattach, then equal-weight CannotRepeat attack alternatives
The three segments use distinct offsets modulo three; no chosen offset is read

DecimillipedeSegmentMiddle.rule: Transition to Dead, then mandatory Reattach, then equal-weight CannotRepeat attack alternatives
The three segments use distinct offsets modulo three; no chosen offset is read

DecimillipedeSegmentBack.rule: Transition to Dead, then mandatory Reattach, then equal-weight CannotRepeat attack alternatives
The three segments use distinct offsets modulo three; no chosen offset is read

WaterfallGiant.rule: Interrupts to About To Blow, then Explode; Pressure Gun belongs to the ordinary move sequence and gains five damage after each use

CorpseSlug.rule: A random cycle offset is assigned; each following slug advances the offset modulo three; only alternatives are published

CorpseSlug.trigger: Another same-side creature dies without removal prevention, while this slug lives
CorpseSlug.rule: Ravenous interrupts with its consuming stun move, marks the slug ravenous and grants Strength equal to Ravenous's amount

ScrollOfBiting.rule: The first three scrolls use distinct offsets modulo three; a fourth scroll, where present, starts More Teeth; no chosen offset is read

TestSubject:MULTI_CLAW_MOVE.rule: Reference hit count is the first use; each completed Multi Claw adds one hit to later uses

WaterfallGiant:PRESSURE_GUN_MOVE.rule: Reference damage is the first Pressure Gun; each completed Pressure Gun adds five damage to later uses

TheForgotten:DREAD.rule: Dread is 13 (15 at Deadly Enemies ascension) plus the owner's Dexterity; without a creature its quantity is absent
